paite: Huchiin, Isaak in Jakob a sama, a vualjawla, thu leng a pia a, a kiangah, Kanan gam nungak te laka mi ji dingin na nei ding ahikei.
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

paite: Thou inla, Paddan-aram gama na nu pa Bethuel inn ah hoh inla, huai a kipan, na nu sanggam pa Laban tanu te laka ji dingin va nei in.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

paite: Huan, Pathian bangkim hih theiin hon vualjawl in, nam om khawm te na hong hih theihna dingin chi tampi hon suang sakin, hon pungsak hen;
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

paite: Na mikhual na gam, Pathianin Abraham kianga a piak na luah na dingin Abraham vualjawlna leng hon tangsak hen, nang leh na suan te leng, achia.
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you, and to your seed with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

paite: Huchiin, Isaak in Jakob a paimangsaka: huan, Paddan-aram gama, Jakob leh Esau nu Rebeka sanggam pa Suria mi Bethuel tapa, Laban kiangah a pai ta hi.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, Rebekah’s brother, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

paite: Huan, Esau in, Isaak Jakob a vualjawla, ji nei dingin Paddan-aram gamah a pai mangsak chih leh, a vualjawl laia, Kanan gam nungak te laka mi ji dingin na nei ding ahi kei;
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan,”

paite: Chiin thu a pia chih leh, Jakobin a nu leh a pa thumangin Paddan-aram gamah a paita chih a theia:
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

paite: Huchiin, Esauin Kanan gam nungak ten a pa Isaak lung a hihkim uh chih a theita;
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

paite: Huchiin Esau Ismael kiangah a vahoha, Abraham tapa Ismael tanu Mahalath, Nebaioth sanggamnu, a ji dingin a ji neihsate a vaneih behlap nawna.
english: Esau went to Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

paite: Huan, Jakob Beer-seba akipanin a pawta, Haran khua lam a juanta.
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

paite: Huan, koilai mun hiam khat a tunga, ni a tum khit jiakin huailaiah a giakta hi; huan, huailaia suang khat a laa; lukhamin a neia, huailaiah ihmu dingin a lumta hi.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

paite: Huan, mang a neia, ngaiin leitung ah lei a hongkidoha, a dawnin van a suna; huan, ngaiin, a tungah Pathian angelten a kah un a kum uhi.
english: He dreamed. Behold, a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

paite: Huan, ngaiin, a dawn ah Toupa a dinga, Kei Toupa, na pu Abraham Pathian leh Isaak Pathian, ka hi: na lupna gam na kiangah leh na suante kiangah kon pe ding;
english: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. The land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your seed.

paite: Huan, na suante leia leivui zahin a om ding ua, tumlam khawngah, suahlam khawngah, mallam khawngah, simlam khawngah na dalhjak dinga: huan, nangah leh na suanah khovela namchih anavak ding uh.
english: Your seed will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your seed will all the families of the earth be blessed.

paite: Huan, ngaiin, na kiangah ka oma, na paina peuh ah kon veng jel ding, hiai gamah ka honpi kiknawn ding; na kianga ka gen ka hih masak kei leh ka honnuse kei ding, achia.
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

paite: Huan, Jakob ihmua hong khangloua, Hiai mun ah Toupa a om ngeingei hi; ken lah ka na theikeia, a chi a.
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

paite: Huchiin, a laua, Hiai mun lauhuai namah e! Hiai mun dang hilou hi, Pathian in nahi ei ve, hiai van kongpi nahi eive, a chi a.
english: He was afraid, and said, “How dreadful is this place! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

paite: Huan, Jakob jingkhangin a thoua, a suang lukham a laa, suangphuh dingin a phuta, a dawn ah sathau a buak hi.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

paite: Huan, huai mun min dingin Bethel a saa: a kho min bel a tungin Luz ahi.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

paite: Huan, Jakobin, Pathian ka kianga a oma, hiai ka paina lampia a honvena, nek ding tanghou leh silh ding puansilh TOUPAN a honpiak ding leh,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

paite: Ka pa in a lungmuangtaka ka pai nawna dingin, Toupa ka Pathian ahi dinga,Hiai suang, suangphuh dinga ka phut leng, Pathian in ahi ding: huan, ka kianga na honpiak ding tengteng ah sawm a khat ka honpe ngeingei ding, chiin thu achiamta hi.
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

paite: Hiai suang, suangphuh dinga ka phut leng, Pathian in ahi ding: huan, ka kianga na honpiak ding tengteng ah sawm a khat ka honpe ngeingei ding, chiin thu achiamta hi.
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give the tenth to you.”
